name: Arizona Open 2011

venue.name: [Brown Mackie College](http://www.brownmackie.edu/phoenix/)
venue.details: Enter through the main entrance and go to the front desk. The competition will be in room 141b.

information: This will be the first annual Arizona Open. It's our hope that as many people as possible can make it as it should be a lot of fun and will hopefully help to build some interest. Registration is also FREE so you have no reason not to come!
